mainEntity.name: What should I ask a tile installer before hiring them?

acceptedAnswer.text: Ask for proof of similar completed projects, clear scope details, and a written quote that includes prep, materials, grout, and cleanup. It also helps to ask how they handle uneven surfaces, moisture issues, and layout decisions.
acceptedAnswer.description: Ask for similar project photos, a detailed written quote, and an explanation of prep, waterproofing, and layout. Those answers reveal whether the installer is prepared for your job.
